brine-shrimp-egg.description: A single small round sphere, not pointed, in dull tan-brown. It has a smooth, slightly matte shell, one shallow dent on one side, and a small soft highlight near the top. Paper-cutout style with a white sticker border.

earth.description: Planet Earth seen from space: a round globe with blue oceans, green and tan continents and a few white cloud swirls

earth-chord-tunnel.description: Planet Earth cut cleanly in half, seen as a flat circular cross-section. A thin outer crust of blue ocean with green land patches, a thick orange-brown mantle, an orange outer core and a glowing yellow inner core at the center. Two small red map pins stand on the surface in the upper part of the circle, about a quarter of the circumference apart. One thin straight dark tunnel connects the two pins as a shallow straight line through the crust and upper mantle, staying well above the core and not passing through the center.

earth-cross-section-tunnel.description: Planet Earth cut cleanly in half to show its insides: a thin outer crust of blue ocean and green land, a thick orange-brown mantle layer, an orange outer core and a glowing yellow inner core at the center, with one thin straight dark tunnel running from the top surface straight down through the center to the bottom surface

glass-block.description: A clear glossy glass cube with smooth rounded edges, pale blue-tinted transparent sides and bright white shine highlights on the corners

human-spine.description: A side view of a human spine: a gently S-curved stack of bone-colored vertebrae separated by soft pink cushion-like discs

kid-figure.description: A calm adult person in paper-cutout style with adult body proportions: short brown hair, a simple neutral face, a red T-shirt, blue jeans or long shorts, and white sneakers. Two arms and two legs are spread out wide as if floating weightlessly. Plain style with no oversized head or rosy cheeks.

protein-blob.description: A single compact, rounded, lumpy blob made of several twisted ribbon loops folded tightly together in purple, teal and orange. The overall outline is irregular and roughly round, with no points, petals or radial symmetry. It looks soft and squishy, in paper-cutout style with a white sticker border.

rice-grain.description: One single grain of white rice, a small elongated oval grain

speedometer.description: A round speedometer dial with a white face, black tick marks around the curved edge, and a red needle pointing far to the right, set in a dark gray rim

stopwatch.description: A round silver stopwatch with a plain white face, small black tick marks around the edge, a single thin black hand, and a round push button on top

sun.description: The Sun: a big glowing yellow-orange ball with a few curling flame-like solar prominences around its edge

teaspoon-glowing-blob.description: A shiny silver teaspoon lying at a slight angle, its oval bowl heaped with a small rounded mound of glowing blue-white material that gives off a soft pale blue glow. Paper-cutout style with a white sticker border.
